summary_1line: Narada and sages urge the Pandavas to undertake holy pilgrimages; Lomasa explains that sinful prosperity is temporary, and the brothers begin visiting sacred tirthas.

image_candidates.scene_text: The Pandavas in bark garments and matted hair, armed with bows and swords, depart eastward with chariots and ascetics after worshipping the gathered sages.
At the confluence of the Ganga and Yamuna at Prayaga, the Pandavas perform ablutions while priests and ascetics stand along the sacred riverbanks.
Lomasa the sage speaks calmly to a troubled Yudhishthira in the forest hermitage, explaining how proud Asuras rose by sin and then fell to destruction.
